title: A literal scalar ending in a line of spaces with no final line break is replaced whole
notes: As `edit/set-literal-ending-in-a-line-of-spaces-to-an-integer`, with the input ending after the spaces (yaml-test-suite L24T, second input). A final line break the input did not have stays missing (docs/edit-semantics.md, Kit conventions). The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend left the line of spaces after the new value.
